subject: Connection to electricity meter for export supply

messages.content:
Hi Team,

This customer is switched in with us for import electricity and is with you for export electricity. They have reported you cannot connect to their meter and hence are not able to compensate them for their export. We had changed the electricity meter on 03/10/2025 under an emergency and the connectivity details of the new meters are as follows:

ESME: 00-1C-55-00-20-18-F1-22 (MSN: 24J0445295)
GSME: 90-4D-C3-00-00-0B-C2-5B
CHF: 88-73-84-20-1E-01-AA-EA	
GPF: 88-73-84-DC-1E-01-AA-EA	

Please establish connection to the correct meter and enable customer's export supply.
